brief: Goldman Sachs FICC and Equities sales recaps Day 2 of its Communacopia and Technology Conference, covering MSFT, NET, AMAT, NOW, TSM, SPOT, CDNS, DELL, CMCSA and ETSY. It reports management statements and does not argue a house view. A common chain runs through the software names: enterprises now judge AI on measured return, so buyers mix models rather than standardise on one provider, and pricing shifts toward consumption and outcome terms. ServiceNow attaches numbers to that chain, 20 internal Level-1 agent roles resolving roughly 90% of routine cases and about $1bn of value created, with more than 60% of net new business on value or consumption pricing. The semis and hardware chain runs from AI and datacentre demand to capex mix: Applied Materials sees leading-edge logic, advanced packaging and memory at roughly 80% of WFE in 2026 and 2027, TSMC cites customer commitments extending toward 2030 and rolling 8-quarter forecasts, and Dell reports a $9.5bn AI server backlog against an installed base still to refresh. Comcast is the counterweight, with fibre overbuild accelerating to 4-5% annually and broadband subscriber pressure still elevated.
